description: Partial warning-only advice for the exact impression route shown by MetaRouter and PRX. Common template slots and supplied IP syntax are checked. MetaRouter mappings do not define universal receiver requiredness; opaque IDs, cachebuster values, custom fields, transport and duplicate selection remain open.

params.name: url_id
params.description: The published impression route reserves a nonempty provisioned URL_ID path slot. Check only physical slot emptiness, without UUID, alphanumeric, account or equality claims.

params.name: path_vpxid
params.description: The published impression route reserves a nonempty provisioned VPXID path slot. Query/form fields cannot fill this slot. Values and path/query consistency remain opaque.

params.name: vpxid
params.description: The provisioned query ID appears in both published producer templates. Presence advice only: identifier grammar, empty values and equality with the opaque path slot remain unvalidated.

params.name: bwb
params.description: Provisioned tag setting included in both producer templates. Presence advice does not infer numeric type, batch meaning, bounds or account validity.

params.name: cb
params.description: Both templates include a cachebuster slot. MetaRouter maps timestamp while PRX uses randomstr, so populated values stay opaque and no numeric, date or freshness rule is imposed.

params.name: ip
params.description: MetaRouter maps context.ip to an IP-address string. Check only submitted populated literals. IP absence is permitted: PRX requires separate data-sharing context, and MetaRouter matching advice is not universal receiver requiredness.
